briefTitle: A Standardized Counseling Approach to Preoperative Education in Transmasculine Individuals Receiving Gender-affirming Surgery
officialTitle: A Standardized Counseling Approach to Preoperative Education in Transmasculine Individuals Receiving Gender-affirming Surgery

eligibility.text:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Any transgender or non-binary individual
* Age 18-65
* Assigned female at birth who desires a gender-affirming hysterectomy with or without oophorectomy
* English-speaking

Exclusion Criteria:

* Non-transgender individuals
* Any transgender individual who has already had a bilateral oophorectomy
* Any transgender person who was born without ovaries or a uterus
* Non-English speaking
